modes.name: trunk_forward
modes.plus: Shifts the trunk forward over the planted feet, with coupled lowering.
modes.minus: Shifts the trunk backward over the planted feet, with coupled lowering.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along x

modes.name: trunk_left
modes.plus: Shifts the trunk left over the planted feet, with coupled roll.
modes.minus: Shifts the trunk right over the planted feet, with coupled roll.

modes.name: trunk_lower
modes.plus: Lowers the trunk by folding all four legs.
modes.minus: Raises the trunk slightly toward the nearly extended home-leg limit.

modes.name: trunk_roll_left
modes.plus: Rolls the trunk toward the left, lowering the left side.
modes.minus: Rolls the trunk toward the right, lowering the right side.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along y

modes.name: trunk_pitch_forward
modes.plus: Pitches the trunk nose downward by folding the front legs while keeping their feet approximately beneath their home positions.
modes.minus: Pitches the trunk nose upward by folding the hind legs while keeping their feet approximately beneath their home positions.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along pitch

modes.name: trunk_yaw_left
modes.plus: Turns the trunk left relative to the planted feet.
modes.minus: Turns the trunk right relative to the planted feet.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along z

modes.name: fl_foot_forward
modes.plus: Moves the freed front-left foot forward and upward.
modes.minus: Moves the freed front-left foot backward and upward.

modes.name: fl_foot_left
modes.plus: Moves the freed front-left foot left and upward.
modes.minus: Moves the freed front-left foot right and upward.

modes.name: fr_foot_forward
modes.plus: Moves the freed front-right foot forward and upward.
modes.minus: Moves the freed front-right foot backward and upward.

modes.name: fr_foot_left
modes.plus: Moves the freed front-right foot left and upward.
modes.minus: Moves the freed front-right foot right and upward.

modes.name: hl_foot_forward
modes.plus: Moves the freed hind-left foot forward and upward.
modes.minus: Moves the freed hind-left foot backward and upward.

modes.name: hl_foot_left
modes.plus: Moves the freed hind-left foot left and upward.
modes.minus: Moves the freed hind-left foot right and upward.

modes.name: hr_foot_forward
modes.plus: Moves the freed hind-right foot forward and upward.
modes.minus: Moves the freed hind-right foot backward and upward.

modes.name: hr_foot_left
modes.plus: Moves the freed hind-right foot left and upward.
modes.minus: Moves the freed hind-right foot right and upward.

modes.name: fl_foot_up
modes.plus: Folds the freed front-left leg to lift its foot strongly upward.
modes.minus: Extends the freed front-left leg slightly downward toward its extension limit.

modes.name: fr_foot_up
modes.plus: Folds the freed front-right leg to lift its foot strongly upward.
modes.minus: Extends the freed front-right leg slightly downward toward its extension limit.

modes.name: hl_foot_up
modes.plus: Folds the freed hind-left leg to lift its foot strongly upward.
modes.minus: Extends the freed hind-left leg slightly downward toward its extension limit.

modes.name: hr_foot_up
modes.plus: Folds the freed hind-right leg to lift its foot strongly upward.
modes.minus: Extends the freed hind-right leg slightly downward toward its extension limit.
